about.title: About SkatalystAI
about.subtitle: We're on a mission to help organizations make sense of their data chaos.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: Every organization struggles with data chaos. Files scattered across drives, documents with inconsistent naming, valuable information buried in folders that no one remembers creating. The average knowledge worker spends 2.5 hours a day searching for information.
mission.p2: SkatalystAI was built to solve this problem. Our AI-powered platform analyzes unstructured data and transforms it into organized, structured assets that teams can actually use.
mission.p3: We believe that data organization shouldn't require a team of engineers or months of manual work. With SkatalystAI, you can go from chaos to clarity in minutes.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.ingestionDesc: Connect to local folders, upload files, or integrate with cloud storage. We support a wide variety of formats including documents, spreadsheets, images, and more.
whatWeDo.analysisDesc: Our advanced AI analyzes your data to detect themes, identify patterns, and understand relationships. We use state-of-the-art language models to make sense of even the messiest data.
whatWeDo.outputDesc: Get organized folder structures, database schemas, and actionable proposals. Choose how you want your data organized and export it in the format that works best for your team.

values.title: Our Values
values.privacyDesc: Your data is yours. We process locally when possible and never store your sensitive information.
values.speedDesc: Time is valuable. We optimize every step to give you results fast, without sacrificing quality.
values.transparencyDesc: Clear pricing, honest communication, and no hidden surprises. You always know what you're getting.
values.userFocusDesc: Built for real people with real problems. We listen to feedback and iterate constantly.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.subtitle: Have questions? We'd love to hear from you.

hero.title: Transform messy data into
hero.subtitle: SKatalyst helps teams turn messy enterprise data into structured, reusable data sources — safely, transparently, and without vendor lock-in.
hero.freeNote: 1GB free. No credit card. You choose where outputs live.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: From chaos to structure in three steps. No coding required.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Point SkatalystAI at local folders, upload files, or connect cloud storage. We scan everything and build an inventory.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our AI detects themes, identifies duplicates, and surfaces relationships. Review the findings and adjust if needed.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Generate SQL schemas, organized folders, or both. Download immediately or deploy to your infrastructure.

useCases.title: Built for real problems
useCases.subtitle: See how different teams use SkatalystAI to solve data chaos.
useCases.operationsProblem: We have 10 years of project files scattered across 5 drives.
useCases.operationsSolution: SkatalystAI scans all sources, detects project themes, and proposes a unified structure with automatic deduplication.
useCases.operationsOutcome: Unified project library in days, not months
useCases.dataEngineerProblem: Our legacy system exports 50 different CSV formats.
useCases.dataEngineerSolution: SkatalystAI analyzes schemas, identifies relationships, and generates normalized database structures ready for migration.
useCases.complianceProblem: We need to audit what customer data exists across our systems.
useCases.complianceSolution: SkatalystAI inventories all data sources, flags PII patterns, and generates data flow documentation automatically.
useCases.complianceOutcome: Complete data inventory for compliance reporting

outputs.schemasDesc: Production-ready SQL with proper types, relationships, and indexes.

trust.title: Your data. Your control.
trust.subtitle: We built SkatalystAI for enterprises that can't compromise on data security. Here's exactly what happens with your data.
trust.noStorageDesc: Files are processed in memory and discarded. Only structural metadata is retained for output generation.
trust.isolatedDesc: Each analysis runs in a dedicated container. No cross-tenant data access is possible.
trust.deletionDesc: Delete all your data and analysis history instantly. No retention periods, no questions.
trust.auditDesc: Full activity logs for compliance. Know exactly what was processed, when, and by whom.
trust.flow1: Your files uploaded via encrypted connection
trust.flow2: Processed in isolated container (your tenant only)
trust.flow4: Outputs generated and delivered to you

faq.title: Common questions
faq.q1: What types of data can SkatalystAI process?
faq.a1: SkatalystAI processes documents (PDF, Word, Excel), structured data (CSV, JSON, XML), images with text (via OCR), and database exports. We support local folders, file uploads, and will soon add cloud storage integrations.
faq.q2: Where does my data go during processing?
faq.a2: Your data is processed in isolated, ephemeral containers. Raw files are never stored on our servers. Only the structural analysis (themes, schemas, relationships) is retained to generate outputs. You can delete all analysis data at any time.
faq.q3: How accurate is the theme detection?
faq.a3: Theme detection accuracy depends on data quality, but typically achieves 85-95% accuracy on well-labeled business documents. Low-confidence items are flagged for manual review, and you can always adjust categorizations before finalizing.
faq.q4: Can I use SkatalystAI with my existing systems?
faq.a4: Yes. SkatalystAI outputs standard formats: SQL schemas, JSON configurations, and organized folder structures. These integrate directly with existing databases, ETL pipelines, and file management systems.

cta.title: Ready to organize your data without building a team?
cta.subtitle: Start with 1GB free. See results in minutes.

ownership.title: You own everything. We enable it.
ownership.subtitle: SkatalystAI is built around a simple principle: your data, your systems, your decisions. We do not claim ownership over your data, the structures we generate, or the applications we help you deploy. Our role is to analyze, propose, document, and deliver — under your control.
ownership.yourDataDesc: You choose where data lives. We analyze it where it is — or help you store it securely if you don't have infrastructure yet.
ownership.yourOutputsDesc: Schemas, scripts, documentation, dashboards, and models are delivered to you as artifacts you fully own.
ownership.yourAppsDesc: If we generate or deploy applications, they are hosted where you choose — on your cloud, your servers, or ours temporarily.
ownership.yourDecisionsDesc: We incorporate your business context, constraints, and priorities into every proposal before anything is built.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Click a category to expand and see all questions

q1.question: Does SKatalyst use its own Microsoft account to access my OneDrive?
q1.answer:
No. Absolutely not.

SKatalyst never logs in using its own Microsoft account to access your data. You connect your own Microsoft account via Microsoft's official sign-in and consent screen.

• Microsoft grants access directly to you, not to SKatalyst
• SKatalyst owns the application registration
• You own the account, identity, and data

q2.question: What credentials does SKatalyst actually have?
q2.answer:
SKatalyst only has:
• An Azure AD application ID (to identify itself to Microsoft)
• A technical client secret (to request OAuth tokens)

These credentials:
✗ Cannot access any OneDrive by themselves
✗ Cannot log in as any user
✗ Cannot bypass user consent

They only say: "This request comes from the SKatalyst AI application."

q3.question: Whose Microsoft account is used during connection?
q3.answer:
Yours. Always.

When you click "Connect OneDrive":
1. You are redirected to Microsoft
2. You sign in with your Microsoft account
3. Microsoft asks you to approve access
4. You can allow or cancel

SKatalyst never sees your password.

q4.question: Is this the same Microsoft account I used to log in to SKatalyst?
q4.answer:
It can be, but it does not have to be.

You may:
• Log in to SKatalyst with one email
• Connect OneDrive from a different Microsoft account

SKatalyst will clearly show which Microsoft account is connected — read-only and transparent.

q5.question: Can SKatalyst see my local OneDrive folder on my computer?
q5.answer:
No.

SKatalyst:
• Does not access your local filesystem
• Does not scan synced OneDrive folders on your Mac or Windows device

To upload local files, you must explicitly use "Local Files" in the data ingestion hub.

q6.question: What exactly does Microsoft ask me to approve?
q6.answer:
Microsoft shows a consent screen with:
• The name "SKatalyst AI"
• The exact permissions requested (e.g. read files you select)
• The Microsoft account you are signing in with

You can:
• Approve
• Cancel
• Revoke access later at any time from Microsoft account settings

q7.question: Can my IT department restrict or revoke access?
q7.answer:
Yes.

Because access is granted via Microsoft OAuth:
• IT admins can control consent policies
• Users or admins can revoke access anytime
• Tokens automatically expire

SKatalyst respects all Microsoft tenant policies.

q1.question: When does SKatalyst actually store my data?
q1.answer:
Only after you explicitly confirm ingestion.

Before confirmation:
• Files are previewed only
• Data is not persisted
• Leaving the workspace discards previews

This is intentional and required for security and compliance.

q2.question: Do you store raw files?
q2.answer: No. We process metadata first, then content during runs. Raw files are not persisted on our servers — only structured outputs.

q3.question: Do we own the generated schema and apps?
q3.answer: Yes. All outputs (schemas, scripts, dashboards, apps) are yours. No vendor lock-in. Export anytime.

q1.question: Can you deploy into our Azure tenant?
q1.answer: Yes. We support deployment to your Azure, AWS, or GCP infrastructure. You maintain full control of your data and systems.

q2.question: Can you connect SharePoint/OneDrive?
q2.answer: Yes! OneDrive connector is now available in preview. SharePoint connector is coming soon. Currently available: local folders, file upload, OneDrive, and database simulations.

q3.question: Can we run without context?
q3.answer: Yes. Context is optional. Without it, we use heuristic analysis. With context, results are more accurate and business-aligned.

q4.question: How do pricing and quotas work?
q4.answer: Free tier includes 1GB data processing, 5 runs/month, and 2 connectors. Pro and Business plans offer more capacity. Pay only for what you use.

q5.question: Why does SKatalyst work this way?
q5.answer:
This design ensures:
• No silent data access
• Clear ownership boundaries
• Enterprise-grade auditability
• GDPR-aligned consent handling

It is the same model used by tools like Notion, Slack, and Zapier.
